name: Yago Gutierrez
biography: Yago is currently studying Telecommunications Engineering. He is an experienced C programmer, tolerates python and has extensive knowledge of Linux Internals. He works as a vulnerability researcher on binaries as well as malware on mobile systems. He is an occasional CTF player and has participated in the ECSC2020 as a member of the Spanish team.
